reason: Nineteen bucks for cold noodles comes to around $23 or $24 once tax and tip go on, and I can get a full plate lunch near Ala Moana for half that. It also says nothing about parking on Kapiolani, so I'd probably just go wherever's easy.
objection: $18.95 for a bowl of cold noodles, plus tax and tip, is a lot, especially when I don't know if I can even park there easily.
would_change_my_mind: A lunch special around $13 to $14 for the naengmyeon, plus knowing there's easy parking or validation nearby.
